info.title: OpenClaw compatibility for the Memory Router
info.description: Conditional Hindsight endpoints for the current OpenClaw integration. With MEMORY_ROUTER_PRINCIPALS, bank_id is a literal Hindsight bank ID. The router checks the principal operation grants for that bank. In legacy shared-token mode, bank_id is a writer ID for the Memory Router. The router resolves that ID to its configured write bank.

200.description: Hindsight-compatible response forwarded through Memory Router

RouterToken.description: Legacy MEMORY_ROUTER_TOKEN. You cannot use this token with principal mode.

PrincipalToken.description: Principal token configured by MEMORY_ROUTER_PRINCIPALS. The token must have the operation scope on the literal target bank.

HumanToken.description: Interactive OIDC login returns a short-lived human session that permits revocation. Bank operations must have the related configured human grant. The session excludes admin operations, metrics, bank administration, and configuration writes.

BankId.name: bank_id
BankId.description: In principal mode, this is the literal target bank ID. The router checks its per-bank grants. In legacy shared-token mode, this is a writer ID for the Memory Router. The router resolves the writer ID to its configured write bank.

BadRequest.description: Malformed path, JSON, body, or route-specific request

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid router or principal bearer token

NotFound.description: Unknown writer or sanitized upstream not-found response

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request is more than the router body or route-specific bound

ValidationOrBlocked.description: Request blocked by router policy or rejected by Hindsight validation

RateLimited.description: The rate or concurrency of retain or recall requests is more than a router quota or an upstream client limit

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the quota window of the router resets, if supplied

UpstreamClientError.description: Any other sanitized upstream Hindsight 4xx response with its original status

ScanUnavailable.description: Request scanner failure or saturation returns request_scan_unavailable. A read-response scan returns facade_scan_unavailable after scanner failure, saturation, or a field or time limit. Response-scan failures after a write return 502 hindsight_response_scan_unavailable without Retry-After. Operational scanner failures do not quarantine content.

UpstreamFailure.description: Hindsight cannot serve the request. Possible causes include redirection, authorization failure, an invalid or oversized response, unsafe content, and other upstream failures. A response-scan failure after a successful upstream write returns hindsight_response_scan_unavailable without Retry-After. The write can be complete. Examine the write status before you retry. The router does not queue a replay.

UpstreamTimeout.description: Hindsight did not respond before the configured timeout

Forbidden.description: The principal does not have the necessary operation scope on the target bank (authorization_denied).
